item.p: Module set (src/xquery_module.c, src/xquery_module_internal.h; glossary ): a work list over the set from the main module. Each module import asks the processor's resolver (kind XQUERY_MODULE) once per location hint, the hint resolved against the importing module's static base URI (its base URI declaration over the host's base or its module URI), or once with an empty uri_reference when it has none and no module of the namespace is loaded. A module is identified by its module URI (glossary): the resource URI, else the absolute hint, else the hint, else the namespace; one met again is the module loaded before, which ends cycles and loads a module once per compilation. The module URI is interned in the name pool, so error records may name it as their source after compilation. Errors: XQST0088, XQST0047 (one namespace imported twice by a prolog), XQST0070 (prefix xml/xmlns, before loading), XQST0059 (no module for a hint or a hintless import, a main module, another namespace); a library module's XPST0003 is located in it.

Imports name namespaces (5.12.2): a module imports every module of the set whose target namespace it imports, itself excepted, and sees their public declarations only (not what they import, not %private).

Static contexts: one per module, read in the reading order (a depth-first walk, imported modules first; a cycle is broken where the walk meets it), so every declared function is an IR function from 2 on and every module's prolog variables are globals numbered after the host's in that order. sxml_xpath_static_context.global_numbers (internal, NULL = position + 1) maps a module's variables in scope (its own, then the imported public ones) to those globals. A library module starts from XQuery's default static context (no host namespaces or variables, its module URI as static base URI, the host's functions and collations); its module declaration and imports bind prefixes (XQST0033); public functions, variables, item types and records outside its target namespace are XQST0048; output declarations XQST0108; a context value with a value XQST0113. Imported public item types are aliases of the importer (read before it). Linking adds the imported public variables and makes the function table find imported public functions and constructors (after the module's own, before the host's); XQST0049 and XQST0034 are checked against them. Duplicate named types are now XQST0146 (5.19), as QT4 expects.

Lowering: the whole set lowers into the main module's unit; each library module's functions and initializers with a lowerer of its own (its static context and AST). The dependency graph of spans every module, so one walk orders all variables and finds XQDY0054 through imports; unreached library variables are never computed.
CLI: sxml xquery imports modules from the local files the hints name (its resolver already served them); a static error in a library module names that module's file.

Not done (each in Proposed below or a later packet): fn:load-xquery-module (needs the evaluator); the static base URI and source name of a library module at run time (cbcl-module-002, base-URI-modules-001, xqhof16, xqhof18, try-catch-map3: the unit has one of each); named item types across an import cycle (modules-43); every module of a namespace for a hintless import (modules-collide-var-001, -fn-001: one request gets one module, as the QT4 driver serves the first); a library module's context value type (contextDecl-050, -051, -054: not checked).

Measured (release, all 737 XQ40 test sets): 39,541 to 39,698 passed, no case lost; prod-ModuleImport 23 to 112 of 141 (94 errors to 1; the rest XQ10-only, schema import or above), prod-AxisStep.J +24, prod-ItemTypeDecl +9, prod-CompNamespaceConstructor +6, fn-id +5, prod-NamedRecordTypeDecl +5, prod-ContextItemDecl +5. misc-HtmlTestSuite (1,379) now gets past its import and stops at fn:parse-html; fn-load-xquery-module (141) and misc-Subtyping (159) stay "not run".
